description: Recreation of the two tonal oscillators of the NES, a pulse wave with four duty cycles and a fixed 32-step triangle

params.text: Sets the pitch in semitones, 54 either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Picks the duty cycle of the pulse wave: 0 for an eighth, 1 for a quarter, 2 for a half and 3 for three quarters

inputs.text: Raises the pitch of both waves by an octave per volt

outputs.text: The NES triangle wave, -5V to 5V, stepping through 32 levels
